scope: New B2 archive, its test, CMake and qualification inventory/driver; unchanged B1/D4-D8 production sources cross-checked against committed qualification.

resolved_design_findings.scenario: Same D8 plan can have different canonical B1 inventory/declaration bytes. PlanIdentity alone is insufficient to pin an original envelope.
resolved_design_findings.resolution: Require an independently known typed SHA-256 of exact canonical B1.1 bytes as well as PlanIdentity, before decode/revalidation. No existing digest/codec changes.

resolved_design_findings.scenario: Exclusive pending creation can have occurred before adoption/stat validation fails; post-open-only uncertainty would misclassify residue.
resolved_design_findings.resolution: Arm archive uncertainty before the create attempt, preserve residue under all exceptions.
resolved_design_findings.regression: pre-write process-death/fault matrix; conservative outcome inspection

resolved_design_findings.scenario: A replaced named file/root or a conflicting final must not be overwritten or incorrectly acknowledged by barrier completion.
resolved_design_findings.resolution: Constrained opens, strict metadata/mount/size gates, pinned/named instance/content rechecks, RENAME_NOREPLACE, exact-only cleanup.

residual_limits: No physical power-loss, privileged mount/owner/source-scanner qualification or nonempty authoritative B2-to-D7 transition.
Caller must provision a durable dedicated root and independently retain/reference the expected original request; no self-authorizing enumeration or archive-root binding bootstrap.
Archive is not a GC root. Caller generation/source lifetime protection remains necessary across State intervals/restarts; missing/stale generations reject.
Writer/mount exclusion and trusted ancestry/configuration are prerequisites. No universal ABA, hostile same-UID/mount-provider or arbitrary concurrency proof.
384 MiB file/envelope bound inherited; multiple bounded strings and canonical decoding can coexist. No aggregate RSS/disk quota or worst-case performance certification.
Cleanup only exact duplicate pending; final record lifecycle, scheduling, B3/B4 and CLI deliberately absent.
LeakSanitizer disabled; ASan/UBSan passes do not prove leak freedom.

fault_coverage.additional: zero/invalid-count writes, short-write/EINTR, short-read/EINTR, partial prefix, wrong bytes/identity, corruption, stale request, missing generations, inode/root substitution, no-replace collision, two fresh-process State-serialized recoveries

physical_witness_distinction: B2 execution roundtrip uses an empty source projection. Same-plan substitution uses intentionally fabricated historical source claims and never executes them. Existing D2/D7 suite exercises local physical witness primitives; these do not qualify a nonempty authoritative B2 source transition.
contract_changes: None to existing production modules/installed public headers/D4-D8 contracts. New internal B2 API and documented caller prerequisites only.
verdict_scope: Nonprivileged implementation qualification under documented filesystem and caller prerequisites.
